name: Nonomiya Chihaya
source:
The younger of the twins. Complete opposite of her sister, she is smart but distant and antisocial. Her true personality comes out only for her sister.

[spoiler] It is later revealed that she has another sister who is Chitose and the one who made the promise. This means that the sisters are trio and not twins. [/spoiler]
